messages:
elaine (CSE): FYI ACME reported ~200 users not getting assigned roles after we rotated their IdP token last night. Some users show as ACTIVE in IdP but are still NOT in their Redwood org groups. Can someone look?
marco (CSE): thanks, any customer repro steps or logs they shared?
elaine (CSE): they said provisioning jobs show 200 OK from IdP side, but our SCIM logs show repeated 409s for group membership patches. They pasted an excerpt (see below). They also tried rescanning groups and it only partially fixed.
avir (eng-identity): pinging in. can you paste the exact SCIM error block and one example user/group id? 409 likely "Conflict" on PATCH membership — could be transient creation race or externalId mismatch.
elaine (CSE): here is the excerpt they pasted: ```2026-03-14T03:12:45Z ERROR scim-sync | patchGroupMembership userId=U12345 groupId=G98765 response=409 body="{\"schemas\":[\"urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error\"],\"detail\":\"Member already exists\",\"status\":\"409\"}"```
marco (CSE): if our sync sees Member already exists but the DB didn't persist mapping, that points at a retry handler swallowing the successful outcome. iirc we suppress duplicate errors and skip acking.
avir (eng-identity): exact. our current flow: attempt PATCH -> if 409 we treat as "idempotent failure" and skip creating DB link, expecting next GET to refresh state. but in low-throughput race after token rotation there was a timing window where the GET returned stale data and the code never retried. i can reproduce locally by forcing the provider to return stale cache for 2s.
avir (eng-identity): quick mitigation: run a full membership reconcile for the affected org (admin console -> org -> SCIM -> Reconcile memberships). that will re-fetch groups and persist correct links. it’s manual but immediate.
elaine (CSE): customer asked if we have an API/cli way to trigger.
avir (eng-identity): yes use our admin API: ```curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/admin/orgs/ORG123/scim/reconcile" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{}'``` will kick a full reconcile job. note it can be heavy if org large.
marco (CSE): also to reduce recurrence, recommend increasing retry/backoff on the PATCH path and treating 409 as a trigger to proactively GET the group and compare members instead of skipping.
elaine (CSE): customer would like ETA for a fix and whether this is why some deprovisioned users stayed active.
avir (eng-identity): deprovisioning gap: if deprovision arrives after a failed patch-of-remove that returned 409, our removal flow may have been skipped similarly. i want to run a postmortem of the code path. i'll open an eng ticket.
avir (eng-identity): initial plan: 1) add an aggressive verification step on 409 to GET the membership and reconcile immediately; 2) extend retry window for 3rd-party 429/5xx/409 race windows; 3) add metrics for "scim-409-reconcile-invoked". aiming for a patch next week and rollout to prod after canary.
elaine (CSE): can you confirm whether this impacts role mapping (group->role) or only membership linking? customer says group->role mapping sometimes didn't apply so users ended up with default role.
avir (eng-identity): it can affect both. if group membership link isn't persisted when the group has a role mapping config, the downstream role-assignment worker won't run. reconcile will re-create links and then the role-assign worker picks them up. we'll add a backfill job as part of the patch.
sre-bot: job scim-reconcile-ORG123 started by api (job_id=job-20260314-19)
marco (CSE): repro steps i used locally (small script): 1) create group G; 2) create user U; 3) intentionally return 409 for first PATCH to /Groups/G; 4) return stale GET for 2s; 5) observe DB missing link. sample payloads below.
marco (CSE): sample SCIM member PATCH payload: ```{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{ "op": "add", "path": "members", "value": [{ "value": "U12345", "display": "alice@example.com" }] }] }```
marco (CSE): sample GET to reproduce stale response: ```GET /scim/v2/Groups/G98765``` -> returns old member list without U12345 for 2s.
avir (eng-identity): thanks. can you capture a full trace for one failing attempt (request ids, response headers)? that will help confirm the race.
elaine (CSE): customer provided this snippet of request/response headers: ```Request-Id: req_abcd1234 X-Provider-Cache: hit Age: 1``` so provider cache age=1s.
avir (eng-identity): confirms race window. short-term mitigation: advise customer to pause IdP token rotation or schedule it during low activity and run reconcile after rotation. medium-term: we'll change logic + backfill.
elaine (CSE): i'll relay that. any rollback plan if our patch causes regressions?
avir (eng-identity): plan: canary in dedicated region -> monitor scim-reconcile-errored and scim-409-rate. if regression, roll back config change. also add an endpoint to manually trigger backfill for specific orgs.
marco (CSE): tagging this as P1 for the affected enterprise customer. creating support ticket: #INC-20260314-ACME. assigning to eng-identity.
elaine (CSE): thanks @avir @marco. i'll update ACME with workaround + reconcile command and give ETA ~5 business days for code fix + backfill.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for eng-identity/patch-409-reconcile to canary on 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z
avir (eng-identity): opened GH issue: redwood/identity#4923 - "Handle SCIM 409 race by immediate GET+reconcile and increase retry/backoff". linking support ticket INC-20260314-ACME.
elaine (CSE): leaving thread open until customer confirms reconcile cleared missing mappings. will follow up. :eyes:
